name: @sapiom/example-newsletter-autopilot
description: Sapiom agent template: on a weekly cron, search a niche, dedupe + rank the sources, curate and write a newsletter issue with an LLM (llm.run), self-edit it against a quality bar with a second chained llm.run call, generate a header image, and email it to your subscriber list (or the agent's own demo inbox with none set).
